reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but re-expresses the daily-skips-weekends rule inline instead of sharing it with getNextDate.

duplication.why: The RSchedule/try-captureBreadcrumb skeleton mirrors getUpcomingDates and the daily weekend-skip condition repeats the one in getNextDate; otherwise new logic.

placement.why: A new server handler next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts, registered in SchedulesHandlers like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and tests.

maintainability.why: Readable with a comment explaining the two-day window, though the daily weekend-skip rule now lives in a second place that must be kept in sync.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily weekend-skip condition in getDatesInRange restates the isDailyWithSkippedWeekends rule of getNextDate openly rather than disguising it.
